verdict.rationale: Grafana ships AI features such as Grafana Assistant, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. However, the evidence only shows Grafana acting as an MCP server (Cloud MCP Server, mcp-grafana) that other agents connect to. That is the server role and cannot be credited to this client-side story, and nothing documents plugging third-party MCP servers into Grafana or its Assistant.
